events.description: When the section enters `composed`, `engine-ready`, `interactive` or `disposed`, or a framework error fails or skips a stage.

events.name: pie-loading-complete
events.description: Once per section and attempt, when the element pre-warm resolves and the item cards can mount.

events.name: element-preload-retry

type.text: CustomEvent<{ componentTag: string; stage: "validate-config" | "iife-load" | "esm-load" | "preloaded-assert"; attempt: number; maxRetries: number; error: string; strategy: string; bundleType: string | null; bundleHost: string; renderablesCount: number; assessmentId?: string; sectionId: string; attemptId?: string }>

events.description: When the rendering items pane's element pre-warm retries a failed load.

events.name: element-preload-error

type.text: CustomEvent<{ componentTag: string; stage: "validate-config" | "iife-load" | "esm-load" | "preloaded-assert"; error: string; strategy: string; bundleType: string | null; bundleHost: string; renderablesCount: number; assessmentId?: string; sectionId: string; attemptId?: string }>

events.description: When the rendering items pane's element pre-warm fails.

events.name: framework-error
events.description: Bubbles from the inner toolkit. For each framework error the runtime reports; a non-recoverable bootstrap error also shows an error banner in place of the slotted content.

events.name: composition-changed
events.description: Bubbles from the inner toolkit. When the bound section's composition changes revision, with a version that increases on each change.

events.name: session-changed

type.text: CustomEvent<{ itemId: string; canonicalItemId: string; sourceRuntimeId: string } & Record<string, unknown>>

events.description: Bubbles from the inner toolkit. When an item's session in the bound section changes, carrying the section's canonical session detail for that item.

events.name: runtime-owned

type.text: CustomEvent<{ runtimeId: string; parentRuntimeId: string | null }>

events.description: Bubbles from the inner toolkit. When the toolkit starts running its own coordinator.

events.name: runtime-inherited

type.text: CustomEvent<{ runtimeId: string; parentRuntimeId: string | null }>

events.description: Bubbles from the inner toolkit. When the toolkit adopts an outer toolkit's coordinator, named by `parentRuntimeId`.

events.name: runtime-ready

type.text: CustomEvent<{ runtimeId: string; coordinator: ToolkitCoordinator; ownership: "owned" | "inherited" }>

events.description: Bubbles from the inner toolkit. Once per coordinator, with or without a section, from which point a host can drive it.

events.name: toolkit-ready

type.text: CustomEvent<{ runtimeId: string; assessmentId: string; sectionId: string; itemPlayer: ItemPlayerConfig; coordinator: ToolkitCoordinator }>

events.description: Bubbles from the inner toolkit. For every section the toolkit initializes, once its section controller resolves.

events.name: section-ready

type.text: CustomEvent<{ sectionId: string; attemptId: string; controller: unknown }>

events.description: Bubbles from the inner toolkit. Right after `toolkit-ready`, with the section's controller or null.

events.name: item-session-changed

type.text: CustomEvent<{ itemId: string; canonicalItemId: string; session: unknown; sessionCommitReason?: "teardown" | "navigate" | "page-hidden" }>

events.description: Bubbles from an item scope when the item player reports a response change; the player's own `session-changed` stops at the scope.

declarations.description: Item card of a section player: renders an item's heading, `<pie-item-toolbar>` and item player inside `<pie-item-scope>`, with a check-answer control when formative delivery is on. The items pane renders one per item and sets its properties.
declarations.name: SectionItemCard

members.name: itemSettings
members.description: The item's policy settings from its assessment item reference, registered through the item scope; they govern the item's own toolbar.

members.name: baseHeadingLevel
members.description: Composition context published by the pane: the level this card's own heading occupies. The card renders it, and the item/passage player beneath derives its outline from the same number — see docs/architecture/composition-context.md.

members.name: formativeView
members.description: Resolved formative delivery state for this item, or null when the section does not deliver formatively. The pane derives it; this card renders it and reports learner actions.

members.name: timedMediaView
members.description: Resolved cue state for this item, or null when the section is not timed media. The pane derives it; this card renders it.

declarations.description: Items pane of a section player: renders the item cards of the current composition and runs the section's element pre-warm. It takes no attributes or properties: it reads the section player it sits in from a context the kernel publishes, so it renders at any depth below one and renders nothing outside one. Only the first connected items pane of a section player renders.
